name: Diabotical

scale.why: player hitbox 57 u tall (game_player_hitbox_height 57, base.games#L75; collision 24 u below the origin, as Quake III's), scaled to 1.8 m: 0.03158 m/u

ground_accel.note: assumed to be the Quake accelerate factor (the same 10 as Quake III / VQL)

friction.note: assumed to be the Quake friction factor (Quake III's 6)

stop_speed.note: read as Quake's stop speed (the same default 100); the engine's formula isn't public

air_accel.note: if the air push is Quake III's (accel 1 toward the full wish speed 320): Quark-equivalent 1 / 10. phy_strafe_jumping 1 (#L126) adds strafe-jump air control whose numbers aren't in the script (x0.0455 is outside the editor's 0.1..5 range: applying it clamps.)

dash.note: no dash in standard play: the Bolt (482 u/s, 3 s cooldown) is a mode skill (Wipeout / Rogue)

crouchSpeed.note: 210 u/s at the hitbox scale; Quark: 4 m/s

boltSpeed.note: the Bolt skill, at the hitbox scale; Quark's dash: 24 m/s

timeTo90.source: derived from this file's speed, ground_accel, friction, stop_speed
timeTo90.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; stop speed read from phy_deceleration_ground; Quark: 0.072 s

stopDistance.source: derived from this file's speed, friction, stop_speed
stopDistance.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; stop speed read from phy_deceleration_ground; Quark: 1.21 m

stopTime.source: derived from this file's speed, friction, stop_speed
stopTime.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; stop speed read from phy_deceleration_ground; Quark: 0.364 s

extras: the Bolt dash and weeballs (grenades) as mode items / skills
Vintage physics (a later alternate preset) isn't covered: its values weren't in the script
notes: Diabotical's shipped scripts/base.games (as the community patch tracker kept it): gravity 800, jump 275, speed 320, ground accel 10, friction 6, ground deceleration 100, air speed 320, air accel 1, crouch speed 210, 125 Hz: VQL-like numbers. The duel / CA / TDM modes don't override them. The engine is closed, so the formulas (and the air mapping) are assumed to be Quake III's. The Rogue tracker's copy (ui/93.js#L1159-1171) has the same values; its newer rogue modes use speed 300 and air accel 1.3.
